findings.reason: §3 must cite reckon/crew/plan_review.py and reckon/crew/routing.py:2629 and shrink to the one genuinely unbuilt half (the refusal launching the review rather than only raising), instead of re-specifying a record and gate that already exist.
findings.text: §3's design comment proposes that "the plan resource gains review state, which it does not have today", a content-keyed staleness rule and a crew-dispatch preflight refusal, as new work; all three are already landed and owned elsewhere: reckon/crew/plan_review.py owns the content-fingerprinted plan-review record (its module docstring states exactly the version-vs-fingerprint rationale the comment re-derivation argues for), routing.py:2629 require_plan_reviewed implements the preflight refusal including its answer-every-finding and waiver paths, flight.plan_review_gate_enforces selects report-vs-enforce, and dispatch.py:5536 wires it

findings.reason: the open followup would dispatch a node to wire something already wired; the plan should record the landed caller and close or rescope it.
findings.text: the followup says dispatch_awaiting_reviews "has no caller" and asks that it be called from the watcher tick; the function is now reached from reckon/crew/resumption.py:1334, whose own comment records that "the follower's cadence, the resume-ready surface and the MCP sweep action all reach sweep", and head-keyed re-review, investigate-role skip and tier selection are pinned by tests/test_reflex_keys_on_reviewed_run_and_head.py, tests/test_reflex_skips_tier_none_reviews.py and tests/test_review_reflex_sweep.py

findings.reason: a reader taking §2 at face value budgets a node to build a reflex the tree already carries.
findings.text: §2's body still frames the reflex as "Nothing creates it", while recovery.py:2239 dispatch_review_for_run composes-and-launches and recovery.py:438 plan_review_subject composes the plan-review run id (this review node itself was produced by that machinery)

findings.reason: §7 contradicts §4 and justifies a parallel edge — reconciling the two or extending the follower is the smaller change.
findings.text: §7 opens "Run state is pull-only… nothing else happens", but §4 of the same plan states "the follower emits on state change", and reckon/crew/runs.py holds the follower delivery registry and its delivered artifacts, so a push edge already exists — yet §7 adds a new optional completion signal to dispatch without naming the follower path or why it cannot carry the finishing classification

findings.reason: the rule is sound and the section's evidence is the plan's strength; the change is to cite staleness.py as the owner to extend so the rule lands once rather than as a new field per surface, which is a scoping note rather than a redesign.
findings.text: §5's shared remedy, "every state a reader acts on carries the time it was observed," duplicates the pattern already implemented in reckon/crew/staleness.py, whose Reading/ReportedReading carry observed_at and refuse to report a figure past its shelf life; §5's freshness-keyed liveness also already exists in recovery.py (_run_stream_mtime, _manifest_freshness)

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — every executable section extends one existing deep module (recovery.py, plan_review.py, runs.py) rather than adding a family of small wrappers over the same machinery.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §3's plan-review record, its content-keyed staleness rule and its dispatch-preflight refusal are already owned by reckon/crew/plan_review.py (gate at reckon/crew/routing.py:2629); §5's "observation time beside state" duplicates the idiom already implemented in reckon/crew/staleness.py.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan's §2 and §3 describe machinery that now exists in the tree (the review reflex and the plan-review record with its dispatch gate), and neither section names the owning code.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — §7 adds a new completion-signal edge to dispatch without saying why the follower delivery path, which already emits on state change, cannot carry the finishing classification.
